status_role: Architecture reconciliation before legacy-model source inventory and before any BL/DP adapter implementation.

PAD_Stream_authorities.geology: SGSim/full 3D geological property fields are the spatial heterogeneity representation. Reduced-order DP descriptors never replace the field.
PAD_Stream_authorities.pressure: Finite-volume pressure remains the exact flow-state authority.
PAD_Stream_authorities.flux: Darcy face fluxes remain conservative and physics-computed.
PAD_Stream_authorities.kinematics: Exact 3-D Pollock geometry and total-flow TOF remain authoritative.
PAD_Stream_authorities.transport_acceptance: A learned transport prediction is a proposal. Accepted saturation must satisfy the frozen physics residual/bounds/inventory rules.
PAD_Stream_authorities.map_back: Conservative path-to-grid map-back remains the accepted 3-D state authority.
PAD_Stream_authorities.recurrence: Sequential recurrence uses the accepted unique grid state/history, not an uncorrected path interpolation.

BL_roles.analytical_BL: Physics teacher for fractional-flow/shock/front behavior where its assumptions apply.
BL_roles.finite_volume_BL_family: Numerical teacher family: incompressible, compressible, capillary, and full compressible-capillary transport.
BL_roles.BL_PI_RNN_family: Learned transport proposal family to be reproduced first against its original 1-D teachers, then transformed to total-flow TOF without changing constitutive physics.
BL_roles.V16D_EXP_CS1: Frozen recurrent control-space Stage-4 evidence baseline. It is a comparison authority only; geology0029 cannot be reused as unseen test.

DP_roles.controlled_reduced_order_benchmark: Dykstra-Parsons is the interpretable layered heterogeneity bridge between 1-D BL transport and fully spatial stochastic SGSim geology.
DP_roles.layer_allocator: DP/layer physics allocates imposed total flow and local pore-volume injection clocks across layers.
DP_roles.aggregation_benchmark: Layer breakthrough, recovery/storage, and producer response are aggregated with the physically appropriate flux/PV weighting.
DP_roles.conditioning_descriptors: Layer k, h, pore volume, rate share, DP severity, and streamline-native F-Phi/Lorenz descriptors may condition/screen transport.
DP_roles.not_connectivity_authority: DP does not replace 3-D pressure/streamline connectivity or SGSim fields.

candidate_roles: frozen V16D EXP-CS1 recurrent proposal branch
selector_policy.reason: The canonical proposal/selector strategy must be evidence-driven after teacher reproduction and identical-state comparisons.
selector_policy.forbidden_at_E0: Do not declare BL PI-RNN, EXP-CS1, or Hybrid DP the final proposal engine by assumption.

required: transport/teacher residual or exact numerical comparison

heterogeneity_policy.forbidden_equivalence: A scalar DP coefficient may not stand in for 3-D connectivity.
